SELECT ri.item_id AS itemId, ri.item_name AS itemName, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT rc.category_name ORDER BY rc.category_name SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS categoryName, ri.disposal_method AS disposalMethod, ri.feature AS feature, ri.caution AS caution, ri.search_keyword AS searchKeyword FROM recycle_item ri JOIN recycle_item_category ric ON ri.item_id = ric.item_id
JOIN recycle_category rc ON ric.category_id = rc.category_id WHERE ri.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY ri.item_id, ri.item_name, ri.disposal_method, ri.feature, ri.caution, ri.search_keyword ORDER BY CASE WHEN ri.item_name = #{keyword} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, ri.item_name
